final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.death_country, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio / NULLIF(step2.overall_avg, 0) FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
